identity_contract: Complete repository-relative source path, including directory and extension; one record per file, empty locator.
metadata_contract: Full parsed authored mapping, including all extension fields, native scalar types, maps, list positions, explicit nulls, and empty collections. Historical missing fields remain absent. No current-writer validation or defaults are applied to historical sources.
discovery_contract: Configured changelogs_dir from deployed commit_guardian.json, then development template fallback, then changelogs default; docs/changelog remains a legacy store. Stores and files must resolve inside root, shared sources are deduplicated, and README.md/index.md plus nested generated files are excluded.
derived_contract: Exact Markdown body after the whole-line closing delimiter
Raw frontmatter text preserving original scalar spelling and quoting
For recoveries: failing field, named rule, exact raw field fragment, and original YAML text/line/column diagnostic

recovery_contract.description: Only a single whole-line double-quoted description with an actual invalid YAML escape is recovered by reversing the writer's quote escaping while preserving literal backslashes.
recovery_contract.migration_steps: Only an actually failing simple two-space dash list is recovered as literal ordered lines. Valid YAML mappings remain mappings, and ambiguous continuation, nested, tagged, quoted or block shapes fail.
recovery_contract.siblings: All sibling fields must parse strictly and retain their values.
recovery_contract.deterministic: Derived provenance contains no temporary checkout path. Two separate checkout locations produce identical records.

mutation_proofs.method: Process-local mutations to the exact imported reader; no implementation files were mutated. Every subprocess exited 1 with target assertion failures.
injections: Silently accept invalid or escaping directory configuration
Strip literal backslashes during description recovery
Coerce a valid migration mapping into a string
Leak absolute checkout path into derived metadata

integration_owner: Root integrates this reader into native metadata projection and publishes the validated snapshot.
